mapper.select: WITH base AS ( SELECT e.dept_id, d.dept_name, NVL(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS pay_sum, NVL(SUM(dd.amount), 0) AS ded_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id JOIN dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction dd ON dd.payslip_id = p.payslip_id /* 세금만 대변 반영하려면: AND dd.deduction_code LIKE 'T%' */ WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id, d.dept_name ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.dept_id) * 2 - 1 AS lineSeq, '급여비용' AS accountName, 'D' AS drcrCode, b.pay_sum AS debitAmt, 0 AS creditAmt, b.dept_name AS deptName, b.dept_id AS deptId, 1001 AS accountId, TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS payDate, '급여분개 '||#{yyyymm} AS note, 'N' AS approvedYn FROM base b UNION ALL SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.dept_id) * 2 AS lineSeq, '근로소득예수금' AS accountName, 'C' AS drcrCode, 0 AS debitAmt, b.ded_sum AS creditAmt, b.dept_name AS deptName, b.dept_id AS deptId, 2101 AS accountId, TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS payDate, '급여분개 '||#{yyyymm} AS note, 'N' AS approvedYn FROM base b ORDER BY lineSeq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_voucher (voucher_id, voucher_no, pay_date, summary_note, approved_yn) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER.NEXTVAL, NULL, LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')), #{token}, 'N' FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pay_voucher v WHERE v.summary_note = #{token} )

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.dept_id) * 2 - 1 AS line_seq, #{accountId}, 'D', b.dept_id, b.pay_sum, 0 FROM ( SELECT e.dept_id, NVL(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS pay_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) b

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.dept_id) * 2 AS line_seq, #{accountId}, 'C', b.dept_id, 0, b.ded_sum FROM ( SELECT e.dept_id, NVL(SUM(dd.amount), 0) AS ded_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction dd ON dd.payslip_id = p.payslip_id /* 세금만 반영하려면: AND dd.deduction_code LIKE 'T%' */ WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) b
